21: MESSAGE_TYPES = {"broadcast", "direct", "system", "subscribe", "unsubscribe"}

24: def timestamp() -> str:
25:     """Return an ISO 8601 timestamp that is unambiguous across time zones."""
26:     return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

29: def make_message(message_type: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:

35: class ClientRegistry:
36:     """A thread-safe mapping of generated client IDs to WebSocket connections."""
37: 
38:     def __init__(self) -> None:
39:         self._clients: dict[str, Any] = {}
40:         self._subscriptions: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
41:         self._lock = threading.RLock()
42: 
43:     def add(self, websocket: Any) -> str:
44:         client_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
45:         with self._lock:
46:             self._clients[client_id] = websocket
47:         return client_id
48: 
49:     def remove(self, client_id: str) -> None:
50:         with self._lock:
51:             self._clients.pop(client_id, None)
52:             for channel in list(self._subscriptions):
53:                 self._subscriptions[channel].discard(client_id)
54:                 if not self._subscriptions[channel]:
55:                     del self._subscriptions[channel]
56: 
57:     def subscribe(self, client_id: str, channel: str) -> None:
58:         with self._lock:
59:             self._subscriptions.setdefault(channel, set()).add(client_id)
60: 
61:     def unsubscribe(self, client_id: str, channel: str) -> None:
62:         with self._lock:
63:             subscribers = self._subscriptions.get(channel)
64:             if subscribers is None:
65:                 return
66:             subscribers.discard(client_id)
67:             if not subscribers:
68:                 del self._subscriptions[channel]
69: 
70:     def get(self, client_id: str) -> Any | None:
71:         with self._lock:
72:             return self._clients.get(client_id)
73: 
74:     def snapshot(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
75:         with self._lock:
76:             return dict(self._clients)
77: 
78:     def channel_snapshot(self) -> dict[str, set[str]]:
79:         with self._lock:
80:             return {channel: set(subscribers) for channel, subscribers in self._subscriptions.items()}
81: 
82:     def channel_subscribers(self, channel: str) -> list[str]:
83:         with self._lock:
84:             return sorted(self._subscriptions.get(channel, set()))

87:         with self._lock:
88:             return len(self._clients)

91: class NotificationServer:
92:     """WebSocket notification server.
93: 
94:     Clients send JSON messages. ``broadcast`` and ``system`` messages are sent
95:     to every connected client. A ``direct`` message is sent to the client ID
96:     in ``payload["client_id"]`` (``target_id`` is accepted as an alias).
97:     """
98: 
99:     def __init__(self, host: str = "localhost", port: int = 8765) -> None:
100:         self.host = host
101:         self.port = port
102:         self.clients = ClientRegistry()
103:         self._server: Any | None = None
104: 
105:     @property
106:     def connected_clients(self) -> int:
107:         return len(self.clients)
108: 
109:     async def process_request(self, _connection: Any, request: Any) -> Response | None:
110:         path = urlsplit(request.path).path
111:         if path == "/channels":
112:             channels = {
113:                 name: len(subscribers) for name, subscribers in self.clients.channel_snapshot().items()
114:             }
115:             return self._json_response({"channels": channels})
116:         if path.startswith("/channels/") and path.endswith("/subscribers"):
117:             name = unquote(path[len("/channels/") : -len("/subscribers")])
118:             if name and "/" not in name:
119:                 return self._json_response(
120:                     {"channel": name, "subscribers": self.clients.channel_subscribers(name)}
121:                 )
122:         if path != "/health":
123:             return None
124:         return self._json_response({"status": "ok", "connected_clients": len(self.clients)})
125: 
126:     @staticmethod
127:     def _json_response(value: dict[str, Any]) -> Response:
128:         body = json.dumps(value).encode()
129:         headers = Headers([("Content-Type", "application/json"), ("Content-Length", str(len(body)))])
130:         return Response(HTTPStatus.OK.value, "OK", headers, body)
131: 
132:     async def handler(self, websocket: Any) -> None:
133:         client_id = self.clients.add(websocket)
134:         await websocket.send(json.dumps(make_message("system", {"event": "connected", "client_id": client_id})))
135:         try:
136:             async for raw_message in websocket:
137:                 await self.handle_message(raw_message, client_id)
138:         except ConnectionClosed:
139:             pass
140:         finally:
141:             self.clients.remove(client_id)
142: 
143:     async def handle_message(self, raw_message: str | bytes, sender_id: str) -> None:
144:         try:
145:             message = json.loads(raw_message)
146:             if not isinstance(message, dict):
147:                 raise ValueError("message must be a JSON object")
148:             message_type = message.get("type")
149:             payload = message.get("payload")
150:             if message_type not in MESSAGE_TYPES:
151:                 raise ValueError("message requires a supported type")
152:             if payload is None:
153:                 payload = {}
154:             if not isinstance(payload, dict):
155:                 raise ValueError("message payload must be an object")
156:         except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
157:             LOGGER.warning("Ignoring invalid message from %s: %s", sender_id, exc)
158:             return
159: 
160:         channel = message.get("channel", payload.get("channel"))
161:         if channel is not None and not isinstance(channel, str):
162:             LOGGER.warning("Ignoring invalid channel from %s", sender_id)
163:             return
164: 
165:         if message_type in {"subscribe", "unsubscribe"}:
166:             if not channel:
167:                 LOGGER.warning("Ignoring %s without a channel from %s", message_type, sender_id)
168:                 return
169:             if message_type == "subscribe":
170:                 self.clients.subscribe(sender_id, channel)
171:             else:
172:                 self.clients.unsubscribe(sender_id, channel)
173:             return
174: 
175:         outgoing = make_message(message_type, payload)
176:         if channel is not None:
177:             outgoing["channel"] = channel
178:         if message_type in {"broadcast", "system"}:
179:             await self.broadcast(outgoing, channel)
180:             return
181: 
182:         target_id = payload.get("client_id", payload.get("target_id"))
183:         if channel is not None and isinstance(target_id, str):
184:             if target_id not in self.clients.channel_subscribers(channel):
185:                 return
186:         target = self.clients.get(target_id) if isinstance(target_id, str) else None
187:         if target is not None:
188:             await self._send(target, outgoing)
189: 
190:     async def _send(self, websocket: Any, message: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
191:         try:
192:             await websocket.send(json.dumps(message))
193:         except ConnectionClosed:
194:             pass
195: 
196:     async def broadcast(self, message: dict[str, Any], channel: str | None = None) -> None:
197:         clients = self.clients.snapshot()
198:         if channel is not None:
199:             subscriber_ids = self.clients.channel_subscribers(channel)
200:             clients = {client_id: clients[client_id] for client_id in subscriber_ids if client_id in clients}
201:         results = await asyncio.gather(
202:             *(self._send(websocket, message) for websocket in clients.values()),
203:             return_exceptions=True,
204:         )
205:         for client_id, result in zip(clients, results):
206:             if isinstance(result, Exception):
207:                 self.clients.remove(client_id)
208: 
209:     async def start(self) -> Any:
210:         self._server = await websockets.serve(
211:             self.handler,
212:             self.host,
213:             self.port,
214:             process_request=self.process_request,
215:         )
216:         return self._server
217: 
218:     async def stop(self) -> None:
219:         if self._server is not None:
220:             self._server.close()
221:             await self._server.wait_closed()
222:             self._server = None
223:

import asyncio
import json

import pytest
import websockets

from app import NotificationServer


async def receive_json(websocket):
    return json.loads(await websocket.recv())


async def http_json(port, path):
    reader, writer = await asyncio.open_connection("127.0.0.1", port)
    writer.write(f"GET {path} HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n".encode())
    await writer.drain()
    response = await reader.read()
    writer.close()
    await writer.wait_closed()
    return json.loads(response.split(b"\r\n\r\n", 1)[1])


@pytest.fixture
async def running_server():
    server = NotificationServer("127.0.0.1", 0)
    await server.start()
    port = server._server.sockets[0].getsockname()[1]
    yield server, port
    await server.stop()


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_clients_receive_unique_ids_and_disconnect_is_clean(running_server):
    server, port = running_server
    first = await websockets.connect(f"ws://127.0.0.1:{port}")
    second = await websockets.connect(f"ws://127.0.0.1:{port}")
    first_message = await receive_json(first)
    second_message = await receive_json(second)

    assert first_message["type"] == "system"
    first_id = first_message["payload"]["client_id"]
    second_id = second_message["payload"]["client_id"]
    assert first_id != second_id
    assert server.connected_clients == 2

    await first.close()
    for _ in range(20):
        if server.connected_clients == 1:
            break
        await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
    assert server.connected_clients == 1
    await second.close()


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_broadcast_reaches_all_clients(running_server):
    server, port = running_server
    first = await websockets.connect(f"ws://127.0.0.1:{port}")
    second = await websockets.connect(f"ws://127.0.0.1:{port}")
    await receive_json(first)
    await receive_json(second)

    await first.send(json.dumps({"type": "broadcast", "payload": {"message": "hello"}}))
    messages = await asyncio.gather(receive_json(first), receive_json(second))
    assert all(message["type"] == "broadcast" for message in messages)
    assert all(message["payload"] == {"message": "hello"} for message in messages)
    assert all(isinstance(message["timestamp"], str) for message in messages)
    await first.close()
    await second.close()


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_direct_message_only_reaches_target(running_server):
    server, port = running_server
    sender = await websockets.connect(f"ws://127.0.0.1:{port}")
    target = await websockets.connect(f"ws://127.0.0.1:{port}")
    await receive_json(sender)
    target_id = (await receive_json(target))["payload"]["client_id"]

    await sender.send(json.dumps({"type": "direct", "payload": {"client_id": target_id, "value": 42}}))
    message = await asyncio.wait_for(receive_json(target), timeout=1)
    assert message["type"] == "direct"
    assert message["payload"]["value"] == 42
    with pytest.raises(asyncio.TimeoutError):
        await asyncio.wait_for(receive_json(sender), timeout=0.05)
    await sender.close()
    await target.close()


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_health_returns_connected_client_count(running_server):
    server, port = running_server
    client = await websockets.connect(f"ws://127.0.0.1:{port}")
    await receive_json(client)

    reader, writer = await asyncio.open_connection("127.0.0.1", port)
    writer.write(b"GET /health HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n")
    await writer.drain()
    response = await reader.read()
    writer.close()
    await writer.wait_closed()

    assert b"200 OK" in response
    body = json.loads(response.split(b"\r\n\r\n", 1)[1])
    assert body == {"status": "ok", "connected_clients": 1}
    await client.close()


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_invalid_json_does_not_disconnect_client(running_server):
    server, port = running_server
    client = await websockets.connect(f"ws://127.0.0.1:{port}")

async def test_servers_share_redis_pubsub_backbone(tmp_path):
    broker = redis.from_url("redis://127.0.0.1:6379/0")
    try:
        await broker.ping()
    except Exception:
        await broker.close()
        pytest.skip("Redis is not running")
    await broker.flushdb()
    first = NotificationServer("127.0.0.1", 0, database_url=f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'first.db'}")
    second = NotificationServer("127.0.0.1", 0, database_url=f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'second.db'}")
    await first.start()
    await second.start()
    first_port = first._server.sockets[0].getsockname()[1]
    second_port = second._server.sockets[0].getsockname()[1]
    left = await websockets.connect(f"ws://127.0.0.1:{first_port}")
    right = await websockets.connect(f"ws://127.0.0.1:{second_port}")
    await receive_json(left)
    await receive_json(right)
    await left.send(json.dumps({"type": "broadcast", "payload": {"shared": True}}))
    messages = await asyncio.gather(receive_json(left), receive_json(right))
    assert [message["payload"] for message in messages] == [{"shared": True}, {"shared": True}]
    await left.close()
    await right.close()
    await first.stop()
    await second.stop()
    await broker.close()
